explication: macshot is a native macOS screenshot and screen-recording app. Its main workflow runs from a user shortcut through capture and an annotation/editor experience to saving, copying, or uploading results. Separate capabilities include stitched scroll capture, OCR and translation, screenshot history, image beautification, and video editing. Edges use README workflow statements or SOURCE INDEX references; several implementation details are unsampled, so the graph omits uncertain internal links.
